title: 批内固定时间步
title_en: Concept Edit Fixed Timestep Per Batch

standard.summary: 同一 batch 内共享同一个 timestep
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Shares one timestep across the whole batch.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 同一 batch 内共享同一个 timestep，适合概念编辑实验时减小批内波动。

advanced_en.principle: Shares a single timestep within each batch, reducing in-batch variance for concept-edit experiments.
